trends.name: Capacity, supply resilience and digitally enabled manufacturing
trends.one_line_so_what: Capacity is being treated as a strategic growth constraint rather than a back-office issue.
trends.current_readout: Capacity is being treated as a strategic growth constraint rather than a back-office issue. Greenfield investment, CDMO expansion, plasma/manufacturing productivity and digitally controlled quality are increasingly tied directly to revenue availability and launch readiness.
trends.financial_reality_check: The latest cycle adds clearer financial proof: Lilly tied $4.5bn to Indiana capacity, Lonza showed growth projects contributing to 16% CER sales growth and a 4.4pp margin increase, while TCS positions at BD and J&J show SIs moving deeper into plant-floor quality and IoT.
supporting_companies: C.H. BOEHRINGER SOHN AG & CO. KG

trends.name: R&D acceleration through portfolio concentration, AI and external innovation
trends.one_line_so_what: Companies are concentrating capital on differentiated late-stage assets, acquiring pipelines, using AI/data to shorten development, and stopping lower-return programs earlier.
trends.current_readout: Companies are concentrating capital on differentiated late-stage assets, acquiring pipelines, using AI/data to shorten development, and stopping lower-return programs earlier.
trends.financial_reality_check: The cycle moved from broad digital ambition to measurable portfolio actions: AbbVie committed about $10.9bn for Apogee, GSK paired £1.9bn savings with more than 20 Phase III starts, Sanofi reprioritized amlitelimab, and Accenture reported trial acceleration at BMS.
supporting_companies: C.H. BOEHRINGER SOHN AG & CO. KG

trends.name: Integrated launch, commercial and patient-access execution
trends.one_line_so_what: Growth is increasingly determined by coordinated launch execution, patient activation, reimbursement, regional channel performance and connected services rather than product approval alone.
trends.current_readout: Growth is increasingly determined by coordinated launch execution, patient activation, reimbursement, regional channel performance and connected services rather than product approval alone.
trends.financial_reality_check: The latest evidence is more financially polarized: Sanofi, J&J and Abbott converted launches into material growth, while Inspire, GN and Smith+Nephew launched corrective commercial programs after reimbursement, channel or adoption weakness.
supporting_companies: C.H. BOEHRINGER SOHN AG & CO. KG
priority_tags: Integrated Marketing and Sales for Pharma & MedTech

trends.name: Margin-funded reinvention and operating-model simplification
trends.one_line_so_what: Life-sciences leaders are using savings, restructuring and portfolio simplification to protect margins while funding R&D, launches and digital transformation.
trends.current_readout: Life-sciences leaders are using savings, restructuring and portfolio simplification to protect margins while funding R&D, launches and digital transformation.
trends.financial_reality_check: The cycle adds explicit reinvestment mechanisms: GSK targets £1.9bn annual savings, Inspire seeks to redeploy about $30m annually, BD is reorganizing around four segments, and Fresenius upgraded EPS guidance while scaling Rejuvenate.
priority_tags: Integrated Marketing and Sales for Pharma & MedTech

trends.name: Data, cloud and AI becoming the operating backbone
trends.one_line_so_what: Cloud, AI, connected-device, analytics and workflow platforms are moving from pilots into cross-functional operating models spanning R&D, manufacturing, supply chain and commercialization.
trends.current_readout: Cloud, AI, connected-device, analytics and workflow platforms are moving from pilots into cross-functional operating models spanning R&D, manufacturing, supply chain and commercialization.
trends.financial_reality_check: Competitor evidence makes the shift tangible: Accenture implemented 30+ GenAI solutions at BMS; TCS runs broad IT/application transformations at GE HealthCare and regulated workflows at AstraZeneca; IBM automated Boston Scientific replenishment.
priority_tags: Integrated Marketing and Sales for Pharma & MedTech
